subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Why Shame Keeps Fraud Hidden
description: Learn Why Shame Keeps Fraud Hidden in one minute.

hook.text: Over 60% of fraud victims never report the crime. The scammer's best protection is the victim's silence.

buildup.text: Victims blame themselves for being foolish, greedy, or naive — even when the con was sophisticated.

discovery.text: Shame is such a powerful silencer that most fraud statistics vastly undercount real losses.

twist.text: Scammers design cons specifically to make reporting feel more painful than the loss itself.

climax.text: Until shame stops silencing victims, fraud will remain the most underreported crime in the world.

punchline.text: The scam ends when the money's gone. The shame keeps it hidden.

quiz.question: Why do most fraud victims never report the crime?
options: The police won't investigate small amounts
Shame and self-blame prevent them from coming forward
They don't know how to report
